# Reaves Dental Practice

> Family dentistry practice in New Hartford and Utica, NY offering comprehensive dental services from preventive care to cosmetic and restorative treatments.

Reaves Dental Practice, led by Dr. Justin Reaves, serves the New Hartford and Utica, New York area with a full range of dental services. The practice combines general family dentistry with specialized treatments including pediatric care, cosmetic dentistry, and advanced procedures like dental implants and laser frenectomy.
